items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: John Marrera basically played, you know, the beat. Real great.

ctx.x: What about banjo players and guitar players?

Banjo players and guitar players? Well it was John Marrera, Caffrey D'Aaron's Boyd, and Son Thomas, and Henry Kimmel. And Cells. They were terrific. And Caffrey D'Aaron's Boyd was one of them. John Marrera basically played, you know, the beat. Real great. John Marrera was a, I should say, name. Boyd played with Sam Marrera was a really good banjo player.
John E. J., was that the other one?

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Simon Marrero, John Marrero, Lawrence Marrero and Eddie... Four brothers... Now, when you'd see John and Simon, they were masters.

ctx.x: Little short Chester here. But Simon Marrero was considered the boss. But his Daddy had been the greatest, you know, Rag to Jazz bass before him -- Billy Marrero. That's what they called him. Old Man Billy Marrero. Simon Marrero, John Marrero, Lawrence Marrero and Eddie... Four brothers. Two banjo players and two bass players. And that was Old Man Billy Marrero's sons. Now, when you'd see John and Simon, they were masters. Eddie was great, but... And as for Lawrence, he wasn't much of a banjo player. But as of…
